process visit.note_wait v1
Subject: case
Stages: [visit]
Start: await_note
Uses: [rule/visit.note_ready]
Requires: [visit@1]
Variables: [{Name=case_ref, Type=Code, IsInput=true}, {Name=note_status, Type=Code, IsInput=false}]
Scenarios: [the note is signed at the first read, the note is signed after two more reads, one of them with a status nobody described, the note is never signed and the front desk learns it was signed meanwhile, the note is never signed and the visit did not happen, a transient failure of the read is retried inside the round, a read that fails for good goes to the chase task, a read that fails on every attempt goes to the chase task, a read without a status makes the rule fail and goes to the chase task, a practice with no connector confirms the note by hand, a practice with no connector confirms that the visit did not happen, a practice not entitled to the connector confirms the note by hand]
step await_note
  Kind: Poll
  Stage: visit
  Routes: [{Label=next, Target=signed}, {Label=onError, Target=chase_note}, {Label=onNotAvailable, Target=confirm_note}, {Label=onNotEntitled, Target=confirm_note}, {Label=onExpired, Target=chase_note}]
  Port: records.note_status
  Retry: {MaxAttempts=3, Backoff=exponential, Initial=00:00:30, Max=00:05:00}
  Rule: visit.note_ready
  Poll: {Field=ready, Until=[yes], Every=01:00:00, Backoff=exponential, Max=08:00:00, MaxDuration=2.00:00:00}
  Inputs: [{Name=case, Variable=case_ref}]
  Facts: [{Name=status, Variable=note_status}]
  Outputs: [{Name=status, Variable=note_status}]
  InputNames: [case_ref, note_status]
  OutputNames: [note_status]
step chase_note
  Kind: HumanTask
  Stage: visit
  Routes: [{Label=on:no_visit, Target=cancelled}, {Label=on:signed, Target=signed}]
  Queue: note_followup
  Outcomes: [signed, no_visit]
  Show: [case_ref, note_status]
  InputNames: [case_ref, note_status]
step confirm_note
  Kind: HumanTask
  Stage: visit
  Routes: [{Label=on:no_visit, Target=cancelled}, {Label=on:signed, Target=signed}]
  Queue: note_confirmation
  Outcomes: [signed, no_visit]
  Show: [case_ref]
  InputNames: [case_ref]
step signed
  Kind: End
  Stage: visit
  Result: note_signed
step cancelled
  Kind: End
  Stage: visit
  Result: visit_cancelled
